. JB Hunt Transport Services Inc. Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2019. JB Hunt Transport Services Inc. announced earnings results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2019. For the third quarter, the company announced total revenue was USD 2,363.660 million compared to USD 2,209.760 million a year ago. Operating income was USD 212.075 million compared to USD 174.688 million a year ago. Net income was USD 151.216 million compared to USD 131.110 million a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 1.4 compared to USD 1.19 a year ago.For the nine months, total revenue was USD 6,714.934 million compared to USD 6,297.032 million a year ago. Operating income was USD 572.963 million compared to USD 558.282 million a year ago. Net income was USD 404.450 million compared to USD 400.904 million a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 3.73 compared to USD 3.63 a year ago.

Hunt Transport Services, Inc. announced the planned succession of the top leadership for J.B. Hunt Transport, Inc.’s Intermodal business unit.
